name: Build and Publish NPM package on release

on:
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      skip-tests:
        description: 'Skip running tests'
        required: false
        default: 'false'

permissions:
  contents: write
  packages: write

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          # Use the ref that triggered the workflow (release tag), fallback to default branch if not set
          ref: ${{ github.ref }}
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org'

      - name: Authenticate to npm
        # Ensure npm can publish using the provided token
        run: echo "//registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken=${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}" > ~/.npmrc

      - name: Install dependencies (detect package manager)
        run: |
          set -e
          if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then
            corepack enable
            corepack prepare pnpm@latest --activate
            pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
          elif [ -f yarn.lock ]; then
            corepack enable
            yarn install --frozen-lockfile
          elif [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
            npm ci
          else
            npm install
          fi

      #- name: Run tests
      #  if: ${{ github.event.inputs.skip-tests != 'true' }}
       # run: |
        #  set -e
          # Only run tests if a "test" script exists
         # if npm run | grep -q ' test'; then
          #  if [ -f yarn.lock ] && command -v yarn >/dev/null 2>&1; then
           #   yarn test --silent
            #else
             # npm test --silent
            #fi
          #else
           # echo "No test script defined — skipping tests."
         # fi

      - name: Build
        run: |
          set -e
          # Only run build if a "build" script exists
          if npm run | grep -q ' build'; then
            if [ -f yarn.lock ] && command -v yarn >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              yarn build
            else
              npm run build
            fi
          else
            echo "No build script defined — skipping build."
          fi

      - name: Publish to npm
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -e
          # Ensure registry auth is set
          npm config set //registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken "${NODE_AUTH_TOKEN}"
          if [ -f package.json ]; then
            # If your package is public and scoped, keep --access public; remove if private
            npm publish --access public
          else
            echo "No package.json found — nothing to publish."
          fi
